calculator_bet_sum_selection_description: The stake amount is shared out evenly between all the accumulator and single bets. For example, the following selections are possible in a bet slip with 4 events: 4 singles; 6 accumulators with 2 events each; 4 accumulators with 3 events each; and 1 accumulator with 4 events. There are 15 possible selections in total, so the total stake is divided by 15.

The total stake amount is divided evenly between all the accumulator bets. For example, the following selections are possible in a bet slip with 4 events: 6 accumulators with 2 events each; 4 accumulators with 3 events each; and 1 accumulator with 4 events. There are 11 possible selections in total, so the total stake is divided by 11.
The total stake amount is divided evenly between all the accumulator bets. For example, a 2/3 system bet with a stake of 150 is considered to be 3 accumulator bets, each with a stake of 50.
calculator_description: You can input any stake value, number of events and their odds into this calculator and it will show you all the possible combinations and potential winnings.
calculator_event_creation_description: Once you have chosen the number of events, all the possible accumulator and single bets for it are created.
calculator_events_selection_description_: You can combine 2-8 bets on different events in a Lucky bet.
You can combine 3-8 bets on different events in a Patent bet.
You can combine 3-20 bets on different events in a System bet.
A system bet must include between 3 and {max_bets} selections on unrelated events.
calculator_express_creation_description: Once a system type has been selected, all the possible accumulators for this type are created. A 2/3 system contains 3 accumulators, while a 2/4 system contains 6.
calculator_formula_description_four: Total stake to be divided equally between all the possible accumulators
calculator_formula_description_one: Number of events that need to win
calculator_formula_description_three: Number of accumulators in the system bet
calculator_system_type_selection_descrip: The system type determines the minimum number of bets that must win. For example, in a 2/3 system bet, at least 2 of the 3 selections must win and one can lose.
calculator_system_type_selection_title: Select the type of system bet
calculator_winnings_calculation_descript: If all the single bets in a Lucky bet win, all the other selections in the bet slip are also deemed to have won. If only one event wins, the winnings for the bet slip are calculated by multiplying the odds of the winning event by the corresponding share of the total stake. The remaining 14 selections are deemed to have lost.

If all the single bets in a Patent bet win, all the other selections in the bet slip are also deemed to have won. If only one event wins, all the accumulators are deemed to have lost. To receive any winnings, at least one selection with two or more outcomes must be correctly predicted.

Winnings from accumulator bets are calculated by multiplying the odds of all the outcomes in the accumulator by the total stake. Winnings from a system bet are calculated by adding together all the winning accumulators.

responsible_gaming_restriction_text_1: Для желающих ограничить участие в азартных играх мы предлагаем услугу самоисключения на добровольной основе, которая позволит игроку закрыть счет или ограничить возможность размещения ставок на срок до 6 месяцев. После того, как аккаунт пройдет такую процедуру, доступ к нему будет закрыт до истечения выбранного срока. Когда период самовыключения закончится, участник пари сможет снова использовать любые Сервисы, предварительно связавшись со Службой поддержки.

taxation_sentence_1: Tax on gambling winings has to be paid at the source of payments, i.e. a bookmaker company (revenue agent) is obliged to calculate, withhold and transfer to the budget the amount of personal income tax at the rate of 13% of the received income (tax base).
taxation_sentence_2: {head}Under article 214.7 paragraph 1{/head} of the Tax Code of the Russian Federation, when determining the taxable amount from gambling income received in the form of winnings from a betting company, the stakes, which are a requirement for engaging in gambling, are deducted from the total winnings amount.
taxation_sentence_3: {head}Under article 226{/head} of the Tax Code, the taxable amount is calculated by the revenue agent on the date the income is actually received.
taxation_sentence_4: Thus, when you make an application for the winnings to be paid, the bookmaker retains 13% of the personal income tax on the difference between the amount of the winning and the amount of the online bet placed.
